_readme: Load-bearing figures. A figure phrase used in two or more articles is a corpus-wide claim and must be registered here with its source; a figure used once is a local worked example and needs no entry. Adding an entry is a claim about the world, so each needs a source and an asOf date, and the scorer reports every entry a change introduces so a reviewer sees them.

notClaims.why: Appears as a band edge in dozens of unrelated ranges (5% to 6%, 5% to 7%) and as an agent commission rate; not one claim
Band edge in yield ranges and the SARB repo rate, which is registered separately as the 10.5% prime it produces
Band edge in modelled yield ranges rather than a single asserted figure
Upper edge of the furnished short-let gross band and of several unrelated ranges
Two unrelated uses: once-off cost differential for a bonded buyer, and a pet-friendly listing share
Duty rate below the nil-rate threshold and a zero in several cost tables; carries no independent claim

A round bracket edge, not a claim. Carries five articles only as the low end of unrelated ranges: deeds-office search fees (R500 to R1,500), Observatory rent spreads (R500 to R1,200), an instalment delta at a 25bp move, and a fixed-charge illustration. Register the specific fee, never the edge.

Same shape as R500, in nine articles. It is the endpoint of ranges for scheme water charges (R800 to R1,500), courier to Cape Town, cleaning per turnover (R350 to R800), parking-bay levy lines (R800 to R1,800) and a gas compliance certificate. Nine unrelated cost categories that happen to bracket at the same round number.
